title: Cigar & Spirit Tasting | Padron
seo_title: Holiday Cigar & Spirit Tasting with Padron in Ozark, MO
description: This is a holiday edition of the Cigar & Spirit Tasting, featuring Padron cigars and a lineup of spirits that is still to be announced. A Best Santa Claus Contest may be added, with a possible special prize for the winner, and a Santa Claus outfit is the suggested attire. It takes place Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO; tickets are $65.
